blocks.headline: Strawberry Blossoms Complete Collection

blocks.text: HOW TO USE: Your Skin Cycling System Night 1: Gently sweep an exfoliating pad over clean, dry skin, focusing on areas with texture, visible pores, and discoloration. Night 2: In the shower, massage the smoothing body scrub into areas with KP and uneven texture then rinse and pat dry. Night 3: Spray the body peel spray directly onto rough, dull areas. Massage in circular motions until peeling particles form, then rinse and pat dry. Warnings BUY AT BOOTS
